description_en: Creates an Enterprise Edition transit router instance
description_zh: 调用CreateTransitRouter接口创建企业版转发路由器实例
kebab_example: aliyun cbn create-transit-router --cen-id cen-j3jzhw1zpau2km0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateTransitRouter

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can generate the parameter value on your client. Make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance ID
parameters.name: cen_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Enterprise Edition transit router instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
企业版转发路由器实例所属地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the Enterprise Edition transit router instance.

The name can be empty or 1 to 128 characters in length, and cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh:
企业版转发路由器实例的名称。

名称可以为空或长度为1～128个字符，不能以http://或https://开头
parameters.name: transit_router_name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the Enterprise Edition transit router instance.

The description can be empty or 1 to 256 characters in length, and cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh:
企业版转发路由器实例的描述。

描述可以为空或长度为1～256个字符，不能以http://或https://开头
parameters.name: transit_router_description

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run on the creation request. The dry run includes permission and instance status checks. Valid values:

false (default): sends a normal request and creates the Enterprise Edition transit router instance after the request passes the check.
true: sends a dry run request and performs only the check without creating the Enterprise Edition transit router instance. The system checks whether required parameters are specified and whether the request format is valid. If the request fails the check, the system returns an error. If the request passes the check, the system returns the error code `DryRunOperation`
parameters.help_zh:
是否对此次创建请求执行预检，包括权限、实例状态校验等。取值：

false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接创建企业版转发路由器实例。
true：发送检查请求，只进行校验，不会创建企业版转发路由器实例。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式等。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the multicast feature for the Enterprise Edition transit router. Valid values:

false (default): disables the feature.
true: enables the feature.

The multicast feature is supported only by Enterprise Edition transit routers in specific regions. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/261356.html operation to query the regions that support the multicast feature
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启企业版转发路由器的组播功能。取值：

false（默认值）：不开启。
true：开启。

仅部分地域的企业版转发路由器支持组播功能，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/261356.html接口查询支持组播功能的地域信息
parameters.name: support_multicast

fields.help_en:
The description of the transit router CIDR block.

The description must be 1 to 256 characters in length
fields.help_zh:
转发路由器地址段的描述信息。

描述长度为1~256个字符
fields.name: description

fields.help_en:
The name of the transit router CIDR block.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length
fields.help_zh:
转发路由器地址段的名称。

名称长度为1~128个字符
fields.name: name

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to allow the system to automatically add a route for the transit router CIDR block to the transit router route table. Valid values:

true (default): allows the system to automatically add the route.
       
     If you select this value, after you create a VPN connection of the private network gateway type and create a route learning correlation for the VPN connection, the system automatically adds a route entry to the transit router route table that has a route learning correlation with the VPN connection:

    The destination CIDR block of the route is a blackhole route for the transit router CIDR block. The transit router CIDR block refers to the CIDR block to which a gateway IP address has been assigned for the IPsec connection.

     The blackhole route is propagated only to the route table of the Virtual Border Router (VBR) instance under the transit router.
false: does not allow the system to automatically add the route
fields.help_zh:
是否允许系统自动在转发路由器路由表中添加转发路由器地址段的路由。

true（默认值）：允许。
       
     如果您选择了允许，则在您创建了私网网关类型的VPN连接，并为私网网关类型的VPN连接创建了路由学习关系后，系统自动在与VPN连接建立路由学习关系的转发路由器路由表中添加一条路由条目：

    目标网段为转发路由器地址段的黑洞路由，其中转发路由器地址段指已为IPsec连接分配网关IP地址的地址段。

     该黑洞路由仅会被传播至转发路由器下边界路由器VBR（Virtual Border Router）实例的路由表中。
false：不允许
fields.name: publish_cidr_route

parameters.help_zh: 转发路由器地址段列表
parameters.name: transit_router_cidr_list

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the resource.

The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length, and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. The tag key cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

You can specify up to 20 tag keys at a time
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。

一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`或者`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https:// `。

一次最多支持输入20个标签的标签键
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the resource.

The tag value cannot be empty. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length, and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. The tag value cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

Each tag key corresponds to a tag value. You can specify up to 20 tag values at a time
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。

一旦传入该值，则不允许为空。支持输入不超过 128 个字符的字符串，不能以 aliyun 或者 acs:开头，不能包含 http://或者 https:// 。

每一个标签键对应一个标签值，一次最多支持输入 20 个标签键对应的标签值
fields.name: value

TransitRouterId.description_en: The Enterprise Edition transit router instance ID, which is used to forward traffic and perform routing. After the instance is created, it is in the Creating state. You must wait until the instance enters the Active state before you can proceed to What to do next. You can invoke the ListTransitRouters operation to query the instance status
TransitRouterId.description_zh: 企业版转发路由器实例ID。创建后实例处于Creating状态，需等待实例变为Active状态后才可进行后续操作，可调用ListTransitRouters查询实例状态
